title: Word Pattern
description: Determine if a string follows the same pattern as a given pattern of characters.
pseudocode:
1. words = s.split(' ')
2. if pattern.length != words.length return false
3. mapPtoW = {}, mapWtoP = {}
4. for i from 0 to pattern.length - 1:
5.   char = pattern[i], word = words[i]
6.   if char in mapPtoW and mapPtoW[char] != word return false
7.   if word in mapWtoP and mapWtoP[word] != char return false
8.   mapPtoW[char] = word, mapWtoP[word] = char

steps.note: Split the string s into an array of words.
Verify if pattern 'b' already maps to 'cat'. It does, continue.
Verify if pattern 'a' already maps to 'dog'. It does, continue.
